rules.statement: The Supreme Court is not entitled to go into the merits of the case, or to dispose of them on any assumption that the decisions of the Supreme Court and the District Court are correct when deciding whether an application for a stay of execution pending appeal to the Privy Council should be allowed or refused.
rules.supporting_quote: In deciding whether an application for a stay of execution pending appeal to the Privy Council should be allowed or refused, the Supreme Court is not entitled to go into the merits of the case, or to dispose of them on any assumption that the decisions of the Supreme Court and the District Court are correct.
